about: Doneraile Park (OPW / Heritage Ireland, free parkland, 8-20h spring and summer, 8-17h autumn and winter per UCC Tree Explorers) round 2. Zero verified: no source (OPW, Heritage Ireland, Irish Examiner 2014 and 2016, UCC, audio guide) names an individual placeable tree; they speak of Beech Avenue, Lime Walk, larches of 1730, oaks above Lady's Well Wood. Only measured trees are two yews on the Ancient Yew Group database, whose own page says exact positions are not known.
